# tar

Create, list and extract uncompressed or gzip-compressed ustar archives.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/tar -czf files.tar.gz documents
moonx cli/tar -tf files.tar
moonx cli/tar -xOf files.tar notes.txt
```

## Common options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--create` | Create an archive. |
| `-t`, `--list` | List member names. |
| `-x`, `--extract` | Extract selected members. |
| `-f VALUE`, `--file VALUE` | Use this archive or - for a standard stream. |
| `-z`, `--gzip` | Use gzip compression. |
| `-O`, `--to-stdout` | Extract file contents to stdout. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-C VALUE`, `--directory VALUE` | Choose an existing extraction directory. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Archives contain regular files and directories with UTF-8 names, octal sizes, fixed modes and zero owners and timestamps. Creation and extraction refuse to overwrite existing files. Extraction validates the archive first and requires a caller-controlled destination tree. Sparse, linked and extended-header members cannot be extracted. The in-memory archive and total payload limit is 64 MiB, with up to 65,535 members.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
